items.description: The increase in shipping attacks comes after a period of relative calm in the war

items.description: Many of the economic policy problems the Fed chair has to deal with stem from the administration

items.description: Decision by former prime minister will trigger by-election in his London seat, with Greens likely to challenge ruling Labour Party

items.description: The ships were hit near Oman on Monday, the latest attacks on vessels in the Persian Gulf. Oil prices rose more than 2 percent.

items.description: The Treasury secretary is also facing pushback on the Trump administration’s trade policies at the global gathering.

items.description: The Defense Department’s Office of Strategic Capital, founded by the Biden administration to give loans to bolster the U.S. defense industry, is helping lead President Trump’s oil deal.

items.description: Squeezed by new trade rules, shrinking market share and labor concerns, Shein’s share decline in Hong Kong on Tuesday is a sign investors have moved on.

items.title: Donald Trump Jr.’s Firm Leads $1 Billion Funding Round for Polymarket
